#### **Week 1: Introduction**

- [Short Introduction to Quantitative Geography](readings/ashortintroductiontoquantitativegeography.pdf){target="_blank"}

[*Practice resources: Highly recommended for beginners*]{.underline}

- [Hands-on R programming](https://rstudio-education.github.io/hopr/starting.html){target="_blank"}
- [Intro to R](https://cengel.github.io/R-intro/){target="_blank"}
- [Intro to R using tidyverse commands](https://openintrostat.github.io/oilabs-tidy/01_intro_to_r/intro_to_r.html){target="_blank"}

------------------------------------------------------------------------

#### **Week 2: Observations, Variables, Geographic Data**

[***Required:***]{.underline}

- Finish [Lesson 1: Language of Data](https://openintrostat.github.io/ims-tutorials/01-data/){target="_blank"}

- [Chapter 1: Hello Data](https://openintro-ims.netlify.app/data-hello){target="_blank"} Note: Also practice the odd number exercises

- [Chapter 1: Intro To Geographic Data](readings/OSullivan_2010_GIA_Chp1.pdf){target="_blank"} Note: Read through page 5 - 28

- [Simplified intro (refresher) to Geographic Data](https://giscommons.org/introduction-concepts/){target="_blank"}

[*Recommended (If you need more R practice)*]{.underline}

- [Getting Started with Data in R](https://moderndive.com/v2/01-getting-started.html){target="_blank"} Note: read/practice until 1.4.6

[*Advanced Practice resources:*]{.underline}

- [Geographic Data in R](https://r.geocompx.org/spatial-class){target="_blank"}

------------------------------------------------------------------------

#### **Week 3: Study Design, Sampling, Geographic Considerations**

[***Required:***]{.underline}

- Finish [Lesson 2 and Lesson 3](https://openintrostat.github.io/ims-tutorials/01-data/){target="_blank"}

- [Chapter 2: Study Design](https://openintro-ims.netlify.app/data-hello){target="_blank"} Note: Practice the odd number exercises until you feel comfortable

- [Flint, Lead, and Zipcodes](https://theconversation.com/how-zip-codes-nearly-masked-the-lead-problem-in-flint-65626){target="_blank"}

- [Lyme Disease and Fried Chicken](readings/lymedisease_ecoFallacy.pdf){target="_blank"}

[*Recommended*]{.underline}

- [Chapter 3: Applications](https://openintro-ims.netlify.app/data-hello){target="_blank"} Note: for practice

------------------------------------------------------------------------

#### **Week 4: Descriptive Statistics, Data Visualization**

[***Required:***]{.underline}

- Finish [Exploratory Data Analysis: Lessons 1, 2 and 3](https://openintrostat.github.io/ims-tutorials/02-explore/){target="_blank"}

- [Exploratory Data Analysis Chapter 4 and 5](https://openintro-ims.netlify.app/exploratory-data-analysis){target="_blank"} (Chapter 6 is optional if you need more practice)

[*Recommended*]{.underline}

- [Catalogue](https://datavizcatalogue.com) of several visualization styles and how to implement them
- [Fantastic resource](https://www.storytellingwithdata.com/) for Do's, and Don'ts and data storytelling
